messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large four-legged creature with the dense shaggy brown fur, head, ears, legs, paws and short stub tail of a brown bear, combined with beetle features. A long glossy dark curved horn with a single tine rises from the center of its forehead. Two large glossy dark reddish-brown beetle shell plates sit on its back, one over the shoulders behind the neck and one over the rear back, with a row of small round dark breathing holes in the fur along the side under the rear plate. Segmented glossy dark chitinous plates also cover the front of the upper front legs.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "bear", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "horn", "where": "on top of the forehead between the ears, curving up and forward"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head on either side of the horn"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in back"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs, broad furry paws with long claws"}, {"looks_like": "bear", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear end of the body as a small furry stub"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "rear shell", "where": "on top of the rear back"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "shoulder shell", "where": "over the shoulders just behind the neck"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "leg plates", "where": "on the front of the two front legs at the upper leg"}, {"looks_like": "beetle", "part": "side holes", "where": "in a row along the side of the torso under the rear shell"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
